2607.07676.title: SkillCenter: A Large-Scale Source-Grounded Skill Library for Autonomous AI Agents
2607.07676.paper_summary: Autonomous AI agents can execute complex tasks with limited human review, yet they often lack the grounded operational knowledge to make their outputs not just executable but correct, secure, and maintainable. We introduce SkillCenter, to our knowledge the largest open skill library for agents by total count: 216,938 structured skills across 24 domain bundles. A SkillGate-filtered pipeline contributes 114,565 source-grounded skills from peer-reviewed journals, ArXiv, and over 24,000 technical sources, integrated with 102,373 community skills from GitHub and the ClawHub marketplace. We present the end-to-end framework that builds the pipeline subset: multi-source acquisition, an LLM-based quality gate (SkillGate), template-driven generation, iterative source-grounding, and quality-controlled publishing. Source grounding is a traceability guarantee: each retained claim maps to an exact quotation in its source. All skills ship as offline-searchable SQLite FTS5 bundles.
2607.07676.paper_summary_zh: 自主 AI 代理可以在有限的人類審查下執行複雜任務，但它們通常缺乏基礎的操作知識，使得它們的輸出不僅可執行，還必須是正確、安全和可維護的。我們介紹 SkillCenter，據我們所知，這是目前最大的開放技能庫，總計有 216,938 種結構化技能，涵蓋 24 個領域包。一個經過 SkillGate 過濾的管道提供了來自同行評審期刊、ArXiv 和超過 24,000 個技術來源的 114,565 種來源基礎技能，並整合了來自 GitHub 和 ClawHub 市場的 102,373 種社群技能。我們展示了構建該管道子集的端到端框架：多來源獲取、基於 LLM 的質量門檻（SkillGate）、模板驅動生成、迭代來源基礎和質量控制發布。來源基礎是一種可追溯性保證：每個保留的主張都映射到其來源中的精確引用。所有技能以離線可搜尋的 SQLite FTS5 包裝發送。
